notes.title: A Moment of Honesty & What’s Ahead for Nephilim Uprising
notes.content:
It’s been a while since our last post, and today we want to speak openly and honestly with everyone who has followed or interacted with Nephilim Uprising.

Our small team has taken some time away to reflect—not just on the direction of Nephilim Uprising, but on the vision of our studio as a whole. We’ve been carefully reviewing the feedback and criticism received over the past few months, including the early reviews. While some of it is hard to hear, it’s important. We’re listening.

As developers—and gamers ourselves—we know the current state of NU doesn’t yet reflect its full potential. But it's important to remember that what you're seeing right now is an open alpha, released to the public so we can test core systems at scale before we move forward. That comes with rough edges. That comes with growing pains. And yes, it comes with mistakes that we are committed to learning from.

We don’t have a big team or outside investors. What we do have is passion, grit, and an unshaken commitment to improve this project. That’s why we’ve made the choice to take more time before the next update—because we want the next phase of Nephilim Uprising to reflect the future we believe it can have.

To be clear:

Nephilim Uprising will remain free to play.

We are not developing this game as a profit-driven product.

We are working hard in the background to sustain development through limited means during tough times.

We appreciate every single person who gave the alpha a shot—even those who criticized it—because that means you cared enough to try it.

Thank you for your time, patience, and honesty. We’re still here, and when we return with the next chapter of Nephilim Uprising, we want it to speak for itself.

Until then—stay sharp.

notes.title: Nephilim Uprising Version 0.0.7 LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated major update for Nephilim Uprising is now live! This update brings a host of new features and improvements, including:

🌟 Updated Visual Graphics: The game has received a visual upgrade with improved graphics.

🎶 Updated Background Music: Immerse yourself in new, dynamic music.

⚔️ New Weapons & Rebalanced Damage: Discover powerful new weapons with updated damage values for a more balanced experience.

📈 Skill and Leveling Systems: Take control of your character’s growth with a new skill and skill point system.

💰 Improved Inventory System: A merchant and selling options have been added, along with a new currency system!

🛡️ Boss Levels Separated: Boss fights now have their own dedicated levels for a more epic battle experience.

🎮 Level Quality & Difficulty Adjustments: Expect improved levels and difficulty adjustments to keep the challenge exciting.

Let us know what you think and share your feedback with the community!

notes.title: Nephilim Uprising Major Monday October 21st – Revamped Gameplay & New Features!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Exciting news for all Nephilim Uprising players—our latest major update is just around the corner! 
Here’s what you can expect:
[/b][/h1]

[b]Updated Visual Graphics:[/b] Experience the game in an all-new light with enhanced visuals.

[b]Updated Background Music:[/b] Dive deeper into the action with newly composed background music to set the tone.

[b]Mob and Player Balance:[/b] We’ve updated health and damage values for mobs and players, creating a better-balanced experience.

[b]New Weapons & Updated Damage:[/b] Unlock powerful new weapons, each with rebalanced damage to match the game’s new difficulty levels.

[b]Skill and Leveling Systems: [/b]A revamped leveling system introduces a skill and skill point system, giving you more control over your character’s progression.

[b]Improved Inventory System:[/b] We’ve added new features, including a merchant, selling options, and overall inventory improvements.

[b]Level Quality & Difficulty Adjustments:[/b] Levels have been improved for a smoother experience, with difficulty adjustments to keep you on your toes.

[b]Currency System:[/b] Collect and use a new in-game currency to make purchases and upgrades.

[b]Boss Level Separation:[/b] Boss battles are now on dedicated levels, separated from regular gameplay for a more focused challenge.

We're excited to bring these changes to you, and keep an eye on this space for more details and prepare to jump back into Nephilim Uprising! ⚔️"

[h3][b]And that’s not all! We’ll be hosting a live stream event shortly after the update drops, showcasing all the new features and answering your burning questions! Stay tuned for the stream date![/b][/h3]
